rationale: Archive International Parking Management as a standalone manager-level PortCo while preserving it as an active Seattle parking-services business acquired and integrated by LAZ Parking. LAZ's April 2024 release describes an asset purchase that added IPM's operations, employees, customers and 14,000 spaces to the LAZ platform. International Parking Management and LAZ are not proven legal duplicates, so no company merge or redirect is appropriate. Argo Infrastructure Partners' directly evidenced manager-level investment is LAZ; IPM is an acquisition beneath that platform. Retain IPM's single Argo audit period as current indirect exposure through LAZ, preserve the 1985 founding, 2006 owner transition and 2024 acquisition history in the archived production record, and record no Argo exit or pending ownership transaction. LAZ's current scorecard does not yet contain an IPM milestone; that scorecard-only omission will be revalidated and handled during LAZ's later authoritative full-company research task and does not alter the Phase 1 list boundary. The approved archive overlay removes IPM from the evaluated manager-level seed list while retaining its legal and audit history in production.

beforeImage.name: International Parking Management
beforeImage.description: International Parking Management provides parking management services in the Seattle market. Its customers include commercial and hospitality properties, event venues, and off-airport parking users that require outsourced parking operations and local market expertise. The business is primarily service-based and cash-flow driven, with site-level operating contracts rather than ownership of large physical infrastructure portfolios. LAZ said at acquisition that the company had approximately 74 employees and managed about $40 million of annual parking revenues. IPM traces its origins to 1985, the business was purchased by Mark and Tracy Sundberg in 2006, and LAZ acquired the company in April 2024.

afterImage.name: International Parking Management
afterImage.description: International Parking Management, Inc. is a Seattle-based parking-services business founded in 1985 as Premier Parking. Mark and Tracy Sundberg purchased the company in 2006. LAZ Parking's April 2024 release described an asset purchase of IPM that added 14,000 spaces to the LAZ family and combined the businesses' Seattle operations; IPM had 74 employees and $40 million in managed revenue at announcement. The exact legal closing date, transaction percentage and retained seller interest were not publicly disclosed. IPM's former domain now redirects to LAZ's official site. Argo Infrastructure Partners' directly evidenced manager-level investment is LAZ, not a separate direct position in IPM. International Parking Management is therefore archived from the standalone manager-level PortCo census as an active acquired operation beneath LAZ, with no legal merge, Argo exit or signed pending ownership transaction identified through August 16, 2026.
